commit.message:
fix: re-pin the historical source ledger after the #125 squash merge (#139)

HISTORICAL_SOURCE_LEDGER.json pins each restored path to its most recent
path commit. #125 was squash-merged, so the pins for install.sh and
installer/install.sh still named the pre-squash branch commit 79cd989,
which is not on main, and structural-pre-acceptance reports the ledger as
stale. Regenerated with `python3 tools/build_historical_source_ledger.py
--write`; only those two commit fields change.

commit.message:
fix: restore project-local free-port scanning (#125)

* fix(installer): initialize bounded port scans before use

Dependent local assignments expanded before start was initialized, so scans returned an occupied port without checking candidates. Split initialization, fail explicitly after 50 occupied candidates, and stop both project-local callers before launcher or registry writes. Preserve each copy's probes and its public containment gate.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* test(installer): cover offline port selection and failure propagation

Exercise both real helpers and project-local callers under Bash 3.2-compatible syntax with stubbed probes and effects. Cover all 50 candidates, peer claims, and failures with errexit disabled or suppressed. Keep original source capsules exact through reversible provenance replacements, and refresh the tracked-byte inventory.

Closes #8

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(provenance): generate installer port-scan receipts

CI rebuilds the source ledger before the canonical gates. Declare the reversible port-scan adaptations in the checked-in generator instead of relying on manually maintained output, add a generator-freshness regression, and refresh the tracked-byte receipt.

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
docs: retire repository-derived identities in archived onboarding (#122)

Remove the owner/repo hash recipe and adjacent Eternity and on-read identity claims without rewriting the surrounding history. Direct readers to pinned RAPP/1 section 6 and the current onboarding/status boundary instead of maintaining another mint implementation.

Add regression coverage for the removed recipe, nearby authority links, and preserved archive markers. Refresh the tracked-byte receipt using the existing documentation checker measurement.

Closes #102
